runtime.eyedropper: Pick a colour from the screen
runtime.eyedropper-missing: The eyedropper is only in Chrome and Edge on a computer
runtime.not-a-colour: This does not read as a colour in {format}
runtime.check-adjusted-dark: The colour is very dark: buttons get the lighter {to} instead of {from}, or they would not stand out from the text.
runtime.check-adjusted-light: The colour is light: buttons get the darker {to} instead of {from}, or their text could not be read.
runtime.check-contrast: Text on a button is hard to read in the {scheme} theme: {ratio} : 1, 4.5 is needed.
runtime.check-grey: The colour is nearly grey: the accents are grey too, and buttons and links stand out little from the text.
runtime.check-status-error: The colour is close to the error colour: an ordinary button and «Delete» will look almost the same.
runtime.check-status-info: The colour is close to the information colour: an accent may read as a hint or a notice.
runtime.check-status-success: The colour is close to the success colour: an accent may read as «Done» or «Paid».
runtime.check-status-warning: The colour is close to the warning colour: an accent may read as «Attention».
